# delete

Delete plugin trace logs

## Usage

```
ppds plugin-traces delete [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trace-id` | yes | The plugin trace ID to delete |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` |  | `bool` |  | Delete ALL plugin traces (requires --force) |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` |  | Preview count without deleting |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--force` |  | `bool` |  | Skip confirmation prompt |
| `--ids` |  | `string` |  | Comma-separated list of trace IDs to delete |
| `--older-than` |  | `string` |  | Delete traces older than this duration (e.g., 7d, 24h, 30m) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
